_comment: Boundaries asserted by tools/archcheck on every build, per STD-GLB-BE-001.
This repository is a shared library, so it carries no domain/app/adapter layers.
What it does carry is a dependency graph that must stay acyclic and intentional:
an edge added by accident is coupling two consuming systems will inherit.
A package absent from internalEdges may import no internal package.
An edge not declared here fails the build.

github.com/jackc/pgx.reason: only db/ names the driver; every other package takes db.Tx, so the driver is named in one place rather than in every service signature
